SELECT s.id, s.name, s.project_id, s.platform, s.marketplace, s.currency, s.sale_price, s.profit, s.margin, s.roi, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_time, p.name AS project_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM ecom_profit_scheme s LEFT JOIN ecom_dev_project p ON p.id = s.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.create_by
s.project_id = #{projectId}
AND (s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY s.id DESC
